clues.text: As a sign for King Hezekiah, this prophet called to the LORD and the shadow went back ten steps.
The LORD's servant went naked and barefoot for three years as a sign against Egypt and Cush.
Jesus told the Pharisees this prophet rightly said of them, "These people honor Me with their lips."
Matthew says John the Baptist was the voice in the wilderness this prophet spoke of.
He came to King Hezekiah, mortally ill, and told him to put his house in order.
In a vision, when the Lord asked, "Whom shall I send?" this prophet answered, "Here am I. Send me!"
After Hezekiah showed his treasures to envoys from Babylon, this prophet warned it would all be carried off there.
